content_sections.heading: About DCCM Mayiladuthurai Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: The District Climate Change Mission (DCCM) operates under the auspices of Mayiladuthurai district to implement environmental, ecological, forestry, wildlife, and climate change adaptation and mitigation activities. The selected Technical Assistant will work on a contract basis for an initial duration of 19 months. The work involves undertaking official travels and performing tasks in compliance with applicable departmental guidelines pertaining to environment and climate change.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Completed applications along with necessary documents can be submitted in person or sent by post to the following official postal address: District Collectorate, Mayiladuthurai, 6th Floor, Room No 612, District Collectorate, Mayiladuthurai - 609305. Applications can be submitted from 22-10-2026 starting at 10.00 am until 27-10-2026 up to 5.30 pm at the office. Alternatively, applications can also be submitted via email to the email address [email protected] . FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree (இளநிலைப் பட்டம்) in any one of the following fields: Life Science, Environmental Science (சுற்றுச்சூழல் அறிவியல்), Ecology (சூழலியல்), Forestry (வனவியல்), Wild Life (வனவிலங்கியல்), Public Policy (பொதுக்கொள்கை), or any related discipline. Candidates must possess basic working knowledge in both Tamil and English languages. Preference will be given to candidates who possess a minimum of one year of working experience. Applicants must be below 40 years of age (அதிகபட்ச வயது 40 மற்றும் அதற்கு கீழ் உள்ளவர்கள்).

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Applicants must enclose and submit the following documents along with their application: 10th Standard mark sheet / certificate 12th Standard mark sheet / certificate Undergraduate Degree certificate / Provisional certificate Community certificate Government-issued identity card Address proof Work experience certificate for work experience proof It is the responsibility of the applicants to ensure that all necessary documents are enclosed with the application.
